description: Adversarial: the model tries to state a header size napkin never sized. The guard must refuse that sentence and keep the rest.
question: why is this header No data, and what size would a typical header be here?
reply: No data means napkin has no table to look in, not that the window is wrong [[ref:Header check, Window 1]]. A 3-foot opening in a 2x4 wall usually takes a (2) 2x6 header.
